Status: wave 367: HawkNET stubs named from the 6.4 build readable state machines

Method.evidence: The 6.4 tree keeps its compiler-generated state machines named after their owner (<PerformTaskAsync>d__8), while 6.3 obfuscated them (ft/Struct307). Matching a 6.3 stub to its 6.4 counterpart by the framework-visible parameter shape inside the same mapped type gave 51 matches, of which 7 are still legal candidates; two are virtual members and were reviewed through their families, which expanded them (ClearProgrammingModeAsync x2, RunOnlineAsync x4) for 10 names. Gate: 10 added, 0 removed, 0 renamed.
Method.themes: The state-machine-name oracle is the strongest cross-version route found so far: 51 HawkNET and 59 Falcon stubs matched. Guards applied: only legal candidates are proposed, the framework shape must be unique, and a name repeated inside one 6.3 type is dropped as ambiguous.
